title: StatelessCalculationEnvelope
description: 1.1.0 (2026-09-04): widened rateJurisdiction to include 'scottish' (bucket enum gains intermediate/advanced/top, the Scottish six-band non-savings set's own-only names) — tax-calc-engine's d074 work genuinely computes and returns Scottish results for sourced years. 1.0.0 is FROZEN and matches its ratified compatibility-manifest hash exactly (rule-packs uk-sa/2025-26@1.0.0 compatibility-manifests.json, resolutionPolicy exact_id_and_hash_only, engineImplementation.resultSchemaHash sha256:99542aa5...) — do not edit 1.0.0 in place; cut a new version instead, as this one does. || Wire contract for the JSON body returned by the tax-calc-engine's POST /api/calculate. C46-COMPAT: authored to back the compatibility-registry `engineImplementation.resultSchemaHash` field (repos/rule-packs/annual/uk-sa/2025-26/1.0.0/compatibility-manifests.json, schema repos/rule-packs/src/annual-definitions.ts:75-106). Envelope level (result/warnings/specials/exclusions/engineVersion/rulesetVersion/inputHash) cross-verified 2026-08-08 between firstlot-suite src/lib/filing/calculation.ts (`StatelessCalculationEnvelope`, `isEnvelope`) and tax-calc-engine FirstLot.TaxCalcEngine.Api/Controllers/StatelessCalculationController.cs `Calculate` — matched, no divergence found. The inner `result` object is sourced from FirstLot.TaxCalcEngine.Core/Serialization/EnvelopeResultJson.cs (`ToEnvelopeShape`), the sole producer of that object; the Suite itself treats `result` as opaque (`Record<string, unknown>`) beyond reading `result.totalIncomeTax`, which it accepts as a 2dp decimal string or number (calculation.ts `engineMoney`) and which the engine always emits as a 2dp decimal string (EnvelopeResultJson `Money`) — confirmed consistent, including against the literal '3486.00' fixture in firstlot-suite src/__tests__/filing/d046-e2e-contract.test.ts:100. IS referenced by the compatibility registry at 1.0.0 (correcting this schema's own earlier, false '1.0.0' claim to the contrary, found 2026-09-04) — this 1.1.0 version is NOT yet referenced by any ratified compatibility-manifest entry; that ratification is a separate, later step, same as 1.0.0's was.

warnings.description: TS `unknown[]`; the engine always emits an empty array today. Item shape intentionally unconstrained — no committed contract exists for a populated warning yet.

specials.description: TS `unknown[]`; the engine always emits an empty array today. Item shape intentionally unconstrained.

exclusions.description: TS `unknown[]`; the engine always emits an empty array today. Item shape intentionally unconstrained.

engineVersion.description: Engine assembly informational version, e.g. '0.9.0' or '0.9.0+<git-sha>'. The Suite pins to exactly APPROVED_TAX_ENGINE_VERSION or that value plus a '+<build-metadata>' suffix (calculation.ts approvedEngineVersion); no separate wire-level format is enforced by the engine itself.

moneyString.description: GBP amount rendered as a fixed 2dp decimal string (C# `decimal.ToString("F2")` in EnvelopeResultJson.Money) rather than a raw JSON number, so no consumer has to trust float round-tripping over the wire.

bucketSlice.description: One per-rate-bucket slice of a band allocation. Mirrors C# BucketSlice (FirstLot.TaxCalcEngine.Core/Models/IncomeTaxResult.cs).

bucket.description: Closed vocabulary observed in FirstLot.TaxCalcEngine.Calculators/Income/IncomeTaxCalculator.cs (Bucket(...) call sites): 'basic'/'higher'/'additional' appear in all three categories; 'starter'/'psa' appear only under `bands.savings` (and, for a Scottish taxpayer, 'starter' also appears under `bands.nonSavings` as the Scottish six-band set's non-savings starter rate — same string, different category array, disambiguated by nesting); 'allowance' appears only under `bands.dividends`; 'intermediate'/'advanced'/'top' appear ONLY under `bands.nonSavings`, and ONLY for a Scottish taxpayer (rateJurisdiction === 'scottish') — Scotland's six-band set replaces the rUK/Welsh three-band basic/higher/additional set for non-savings only (savings/dividends stay flat rUK-rate for every jurisdiction, HMRC MTR Stage 17). This schema does not further restrict which subset applies to which array.

rate.description: Statutory rate as a fraction (e.g. 0.20). Not money — stays a JSON number (EnvelopeResultJson doc comment).

rateJurisdiction.description: 'scottish' now appears here for a sourced tax year (2024-25, 2025-26, 2026-27 — the per-year `scottish:` YAML block, d074) with the Scottish six-band non-savings set reflected in `bands.nonSavings` (see the `bucket` enum). For an UNSOURCED year the engine still refuses closed with a typed 422 JURISDICTION_UNSUPPORTED before any result is produced (IncomeTaxResult.cs doc comment) — 'scottish' in this field means the result was actually computed, not merely requested.
